name: MAAP
verdict: Private Australian cycling-apparel company; nothing found.
note: Melbourne-founded cycling-apparel maker; official technical supplier to GreenEDGE Cycling and its logo is on the 2026 Team Jayco AlUla jersey. Its co-founder told Cycling Weekly it is a private company with no stock price. Unchecked lead (see PR): a 2019 investment by L Catterton is suggested by aggregator pages, but no primary source could be opened.
